# rt/test

> A tiny test library: checks that print FAIL lines, and a final PASS or FAILED.

truck [rt](../rt.md) · [source](../../../registry/rt/test.pkg)

```
use std
use rt/test

test_int(1 + 1, 2, "addition")
test_str("a", "a", "strings")
test_true(3 > 2, "comparison")
return test_done()
```

`test_done()` prints `PASS` (and returns 0) if every check passed,
otherwise `FAILED` (and returns 1), so `return test_done()` sets the exit
status. The tests of the `rt` truck are written with it, in
[tests/rt](../../../tests/rt).

## Needs

- [std](../std.md)

## Library code

Merged into every program that uses this package.

```
global test_checks: int = 0
global test_failures: int = 0

fn test_true(ok: bool, what: str)
  test_checks = test_checks + 1
  if !ok
    test_failures = test_failures + 1
    print "FAIL"
    print what
  end
end

fn test_int(got: int, want: int, what: str)
  test_checks = test_checks + 1
  if got != want
    test_failures = test_failures + 1
    print "FAIL"
    print what
    print got
    print want
  end
end

fn test_str(got: str, want: str, what: str)
  test_checks = test_checks + 1
  if got != want
    test_failures = test_failures + 1
    print "FAIL"
    print what
    print got
    print want
  end
end

fn test_done() -> int
  if test_failures == 0
    print "PASS"
    return 0
  end
  print "FAILED"
  return 1
end
```
